entities.summary: Sierra Leone is a sovereign nation in West Africa, Africa. Its capital is Freetown. Official languages include English. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 8.8 million. Area: 71,740 km². Comprehensive index for Sierra Leone covering indigenous Temne and Mende peoples, Province of Freedom, Freetown settlement, Krio culture, British colony and protectorate, Hut Tax War, independence, RUF civil war (blood diamonds), Ebola crisis, and post-conflict recovery.
